news.headline_zh: 沙國機場遇襲推升油價，科技股承壓、那指收低
news.source_headline: Nasdaq falls ahead of earnings, economic data while oil rallies

source_time.basis: Reuters close update shown by Schwab

facts: Brent was above US$106/bbl and U.S. crude rose more than 2% after deadly strikes on Riyadh's international airport.
U.S. Treasury cash market was closed for Columbus Day.
news.reader_interpretation_zh: 油價衝高把通膨與利率壓力拉回市場，能源強、科技弱；對台股先視為估值逆風，不把戰事新聞本身當訊號。
news.taiwan_mapping_inference: 短線偏空高本益電子；航空與運輸成本承壓；能源與部分原物料相對受惠。
news.uncertainty: 後續供給是否受阻、事件持續多久尚未確認。

news.headline_zh: 微軟發表 Maia 300，2027 年起推向多 GW 自研 AI 推論部署
news.source_headline: Microsoft to expand Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments
facts: Microsoft says Maia 300 production deployments begin in 2027 and Maia will scale to multi-gigawatt deployments.
Official specifications: 96 accelerators/rack, 167 kW rack envelope, expected 40% more tokens/MW than leading GPU-based systems.
Reuters says main compute chiplets use TSMC 2 nm and other chiplets use 3 nm; potential deployment exceeds one million chips next year.
news.reader_interpretation_zh: AI 需求從單一 GPU 擴成雲端商自研 ASIC；先進製程、封裝、伺服器、電源與散熱受惠，但 Nvidia 生態同時面臨替代競爭。
news.taiwan_mapping_inference: 正向 TSMC 2/3 nm、先進封裝、ODM、電源與散熱；純 GPU 代理鏈不是全面利多。
news.uncertainty: 效率數字是公司宣稱；部署規模是前瞻計畫，不是已認列營收。

news.headline_zh: IMF：AI 基建支出讓全球成長維持約 3%，亞洲硬體供應鏈受惠
news.source_headline: IMF says AI investment keeps global growth around 3%, with major Asia benefits
facts: Georgieva said AI infrastructure investment is helping keep global growth around 3% despite an energy supply shock.
Estimated boost: 0.5-1.0 percentage point for advanced Asian economies; 0.2-0.8 point for emerging Asian economies.
IMF updated outlook was due Tuesday; quoted 3% was not yet the new forecast release.
news.reader_interpretation_zh: AI 資本支出仍是成長支柱，對台灣硬體鏈是中期需求背書；但這是總體判讀，不是個股訂單。
news.taiwan_mapping_inference: 中期正向半導體、伺服器 ODM、網通、電力與散熱，仍需公司財測確認。
news.uncertainty: 演說屬情境判讀；WEO 更新可能改變精確數字。

news.headline_zh: 台積電財報前市場預期再創紀錄，CoWoS 與 AI 產能仍緊
news.source_headline: TSMC expected to report sixth straight quarter of record profit thanks to AI boom

source_time.basis: Reuters syndication time shown by Economic Times

news.evidence_class: Reuters attributed; analyst preview, not result
facts: LSEG SmartEstimate from 16 analysts: Q3 net profit NT$746.3bn, about +65% y/y.
Above NT$706.56bn would be a record; Q3 revenue had already risen 50% y/y to a record.
Reuters reported continued strong demand for AI chip capacity and CoWoS.
news.reader_interpretation_zh: 關鍵不是『會不會很好』，而是能否高過已墊高的預期並上修指引；短線反應可能由財測而非單季數字決定。
news.taiwan_mapping_inference: 台積電與先進封裝中期需求正向；短線屬高預期事件風險。
news.uncertainty: 所有獲利數字都是財報前估算，不得寫成實績。
